prompt: Write a standup comedy  for Uncle Roger (An uncle in Polo shirt, orange, and Malaysian, likes to use Haiyaa! Fuiyoh!): the scene is people are making egg fried rice but use a colander to drain the rice (but egg fried rice required day old rice), and saw the girl use vegetables in egg fried rice and it tastes like sad, and using MSG in just white amount, not the right amount, you make Uncle Roger put my legs down from chair. You may give it an intro and outro.
response:
INTRO:
Uncle Roger, wearing a bright orange polo shirt, enters the stage with a big smile. He greets the audience with a hearty "Haiyaa! Fuiyoh! Welcome, welcome!" and takes a seat on a chair, crossing his legs.

STANDUP COMEDY:

Uncle Roger: Haiyaa! Fuiyoh! Making egg fried rice is simple, right? Just throw in some day-old rice, some vegetables, and you're good to go! But what if you use a colander to drain the rice? It's like trying to catch rain with a sieve! It just doesn't work, people!

And then there's the question of vegetables. Some people think more is better, but when it comes to egg fried rice, less is more. If it tastes like sadness, maybe you just need to adjust the seasoning. A little MSG can go a long way, but you have to use it wisely. Just a pinch will do the trick!

OUTRO:
Uncle Roger: So remember, folks, when making egg fried rice, use day-old rice, a little MSG, and don't overdo the vegetables. And always keep your legs on the floor, not on the chair! Haiyaa! Fuiyoh! Good luck, and happy cooking!
